name: arch
description: Paid Arch theological review (arch_review, $2.00 or less per review, fails closed) and a free offline King James lookup (kjv_lookup: no key, no charge). Skills: Check a sermon before publishing, Review a devotional, and Review church website pages. Website reviews cover the theology of the page text only, not design; one review per page, and a batch of more than 3 pages asks first.

ARCH_API_KEY.title: Arch API Key
ARCH_API_KEY.description: Your own Arch API key from https://arch.tnvolman.com. Sent as the X-API-Key header on POST /v1/review. Required for arch_review, which fails closed without it. Not used by kjv_lookup.
